scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/client" "npm run dev -w packages/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/prisma && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/prisma && npm run typecheck -w packages/server && npm run typecheck -w packages/client
scripts.icons:audit: grep -rP '[\x{1F600}-\x{1F64F}\x{1F300}-\x{1F5FF}\x{1F680}-\x{1F6FF}\x{1F1E0}-\x{1F1FF}\x{2600}-\x{26FF}\x{2700}-\x{27BF}\x{FE00}-\x{FE0F}\x{1F900}-\x{1F9FF}\x{1FA00}-\x{1FA6F}\x{1FA70}-\x{1FAFF}\x{200D}\x{20E3}]' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.css' --include='*.html' --include='*.json' --include='*.md' packages/ || echo 'CLEAN: No emojis found'
